description: Hough line detection and segment pattern inference parameters for Tunnel 1-4

k_block_detection.description: Dynamic K-block position detection via V-pair inverse mapping

algorithm.step1: Detect V-pairs (oblique line pairs with K_HEIGHT spacing)
algorithm.step2: V-pairs appear at ALTERNATE K position (where K is NOT for that ring)
algorithm.step3: Cluster V-pair midpoints into distinct positions
algorithm.step5: Classify rings: V-pair near template1 → K at pos2 (inverse mapping)
algorithm.step6: Infer alternation pattern from detected rings (even→pos_X, odd→pos_Y)
algorithm.step7: Propagate to undetected rings using inferred pattern

k_block_detection.notes: Key insight: V-pairs are detected at the ALTERNATE K position due to segment boundary visibility patterns. Uses only physical constants (K_HEIGHT, AB_HEIGHT, resolution). Works best for 6-segment alternating tunnels.
